# VaultScaler

> VaultScaler makes thoughtfully designed software. Its first product is Takes, a writing workspace built around speaking. Based in Las Vegas.

VaultScaler no longer offers consulting services.

## Takes

Takes is a writing workspace built around speaking. You say a thought and Takes keeps it as a take: the words, recognised on your Mac, and the original recording. You gather the takes you want into a manuscript, arrange them with chapter and section headings, and return to your work where you left it. Each book, essay or article is its own project, with a history of earlier versions.

- Platforms: macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon. Not available for Intel Macs, Windows or Linux.
- Availability: the first Mac preview is being prepared and is not yet available to download.
- Privacy: recordings, writing and transcription stay on the Mac. No account, no analytics. The app uses the internet only to check for and download signed updates from vaultscaler.com.
- Limits: transcription makes mistakes (the recording is kept so you can check); English only; not hands-free.
